newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -July 23.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -July 23.

text.p: REUTERS FRENCH ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST
News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media, the Internet and Brand-name Products.
ADVERTISING, MEDIA & THE INTERNET:

DUBAI - Arab satellite operator Arabsat will not reconsider its ban on a French channel for violating Islamic views of decency, Arabsat's director general said. France apologises for the mistake, saying it was unacceptable, and a Kuwaiti columnist blasts Arabsat for banning CFI.(Reuter)
PARIS - Design agencies are increasingly taking on brand communication in a partial convergence of their profession with advertising. (Le Figaro)
PARIS - French household consumption fell in June after recovering in May, with textiles and clothing and footwear showing a marked slide. (Le Parisien)
BRAND-NAME PRODUCTS & MARKETS:

PARIS - France's LVMH raises its stake in Grand Metropolitan to more than 10 percent. Analysts say LVMH chairman Bernard Arnault looks set to derail one of the biggest mergers in British corporate history and to oblige Guinness and Grand Met to swallow his plan for a three-way drinks merger (Reuter)
BRUSSELS - Workers at French carmaker Renault's doomed plant at Vilvoorde in Belgium voted overwhelmingly on Tuesday to accept a redundancy deal. (Reuter)

ABIDJAN - Franco-Dutch partnership Orexis plans to open a cocoa processing factory in Ivory Coast by summer 1998 but has still to reach a deal with Ivorian officials, an Orexis spokesman says.(Reuter)
PARIS - Alain Afflelou, who founded his French nationwide optician's chain on a novel advertising approach, sells 70 percent of his company to an investment fund. (La Tribune, Le Parisien)

PARIS - Sales of cigarettes in France fall five percent in the first six months of 1997, mainly because of a nine percent price hike in December last year, according to the tobacco information centre. (La Tribune)
PEOPLE NEWS:
French retail group Carrefour says La Redoute managing director Joel Saveuse will join its management board in September. (Reuter)
PARIS - Patrick de Carolis, information director at French private television channel M6, is to become director of magazine programmes at France 3. (Le Parisien)
